title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.37390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. translated_title: LinMix：将数据混合视为线性域归因
translated_abstract: 语言模型的性能在很大程度上取决于预训练数据语料库中各领域数据的混合比例。流行的数据混合方法通过在随机混合的数据上训练许多小型代理模型，再拟合一个回归模型来从混合比例预测性能，从而选择这些领域权重。我们将这一做法视为一个领域归因问题，其中回归衡量每个领域对目标指标的贡献。从这一视角看，对代理数据混合进行标准的狄利克雷采样是一种糟糕的回归设计：它需要调参，且无法支持对数百个领域进行线性拟合。基于经典的最优实验设计，我们提出LinMix，它在带顶点约束的单纯形顶点处采样混合，使每个领域要么达到其上限，要么完全缺失。这种无超参数的顶点采样使各领域的效应去相关，从而得到一个可解释的线性模型，其系数即为各领域的归因。最优混合……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LinMix将数据混合建模为线性域归因问题，通过对带顶点约束的单纯形进行无超参数的顶点采样使各领域效应去相关，从而用可解释的线性模型系数直接读出每个领域对模型性能的贡献。
en_tdlr: LinMix reframes data mixing as linear domain attribution, using hyperparameter-free vertex sampling on the capped simplex to decorrelate domain effects, yielding an interpretable linear model whose coefficients directly quantify each domain's contribution to model performance.
